## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and affected roadmap item.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm format:check`
- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Updated project-specific validation or documentation where applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, private data, or fabricated user content are included.
- [ ] The roadmap status accurately reflects the available evidence.
- [ ] Setup, behavior, or platform-support documentation is updated where needed.
